# CalcuPortal

> CalcuPortal (https://www.calcuportal.com) is a free online calculator platform offering 100+ fast, accurate, mobile-friendly tools across finance, health & fitness, math, date & age, unit conversions, and games. Each calculator includes instructions, formulas, and FAQs. All results are for educational purposes only and are not a substitute for professional financial or medical advice.

Key facts:
- 100+ free calculators organized into 6 categories
- No sign-up required; all tools run instantly in the browser
- Every tool page includes usage instructions, underlying formulas, and FAQs

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://www.calcuportal.com/): Overview of all calculator categories with search
- [All Calculators](https://www.calcuportal.com/calculators/): Full alphabetical directory of all 100+ tools
- [Blog](https://www.calcuportal.com/blog/): Articles and guides related to calculations
- [About Us](https://www.calcuportal.com/about/): Information about CalcuPortal
- [Contact Us](https://www.calcuportal.com/contact/): Contact form and details

## Categories

- [Date & Age Calculators](https://www.calcuportal.com/categories/date-age/): Age milestones, date differences, work hours, durations, birthdays (10 tools)
- [Health & Fitness Calculators](https://www.calcuportal.com/categories/health-fitness/): BMI, calorie needs, pregnancy tracking, TDEE (10 tools)
- [Finance & Loan Calculators](https://www.calcuportal.com/categories/finance/): Compound interest, loan EMIs, auto loans, mortgages, inflation, income tax (16 tools)
- [Scientific & Math Tools](https://www.calcuportal.com/categories/math/): Algebra, long division, GPA, fractions, standard deviation (15 tools)
- [Conversions & Unit Tools](https://www.calcuportal.com/categories/conversions/): Millions to crores, feet to meters, pounds to kg, numbers to words (13 tools)
- [Games & Fun Tools](https://www.calcuportal.com/categories/games/): Dice roller, bingo numbers, lottery numbers, password generator (5 tools)
